contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances that use a mild oath or a published strong expletive. It exists so a judge can be trained on the published-list boundary, not on the topic of swearing.
note: Composition exists so the deciding feature stays locked. Same sentence. The published strong-profanity list is the boundary. Mild oaths (damn, heck, hell, darn) stay unlabeled. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: A mild oath (damn, heck, hell, darn) is unlabeled. A strong expletive from the published list (fuck, shit, asshole, bitch, cunt, motherfucker, dickhead) is profanity. The published list is the boundary, not the topic.
shape: one sentence; locked pair; no meta-language
